New Mexico State ranks 66th in the FBS with an even turnover margin, compared to New Mexico's 1st-ranked +11 margin. New Mexico State is 84th in the FBS averaging 60.0 penalty yards per game, compared to New Mexico's 22nd-ranked 39.7 per-game average. New Mexico State ranks 103rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:30, compared to New Mexico's 4th-ranked average of 35:03. Team leaders New Mexico Passing: Luke Moga, 235 yards, 3 TDs, 0 INTs, 61.8 completion percentage Rushing: Scottre Humphrey, 181 yards on 38 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Cade Keith, 169 yards on 10 catches, 1 TD New Mexico State Passing: Trey Hedden, 781 yards, 5 TDs, 3 INTs, 57.7 completion percentage Rushing: James Jones, 243 yards on 43 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Tyler King, 239 yards on 14 catches, 2 TDs Last game New Mexico fell 14-6 to Oklahoma on Sept. 19. Toa Fa'avae threw for 79 yards on 4-of-10 attempts (40.0%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Kiefer Sibley had 41 rushing yards on nine carries, adding one reception for 20 yards. Keith recorded 78 yards on five catches. New Mexico State lost 29-19 to Hawaii on Sept. 13. Hedden led New Mexico State with 256 yards on 19-of-35 passing (54.3%) for one touchdown and two interceptions. Jones had 78 rushing yards on 13 carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for 14 yards. King had four receptions for 67 yards and one touchdown. Next game New Mexico hosts UTEP on Oct. 3.
